title: Unit check
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Ali Baba and the forty thieves; occasions
source: Written for arabic/y6 lesson 14 (Pupil PDF worksheet: unit check)
intro: Lesson 14: Review and check: the story, verbs and occasions. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
فِي يَوْمِ العِيدِ يَلْبَسُ عُمَرُ ثِيَابًا جَدِيدَةً.
يَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَسْجِدِ مَعَ أَبِيهِ.
بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ يَقُولُ: عِيدٌ مُبَارَكٌ!
arabic.ref: Our own text for the Year 6 check

questions.q: Change to the past: يَذْهَبُ عُمَرُ إِلَى المَسْجِدِ.
Check on the pupil PDF: read the text and answer three questions, change four verbs, write three sentences about Eid; then say them to the camera.
questions.a: Answers, verbs and sentences from the unit

questions.q: Extend: write the story lesson in Arabic.

questions.a: A) إِلَى المَسْجِدِ. يَذْهَبُ إِلَى المَسْجِدِ مَعَ أَبِيهِ.
